content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow : Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship and GATE, Selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies. Additional requirements: BE/B.Tech in Civil/Construction Engineering with 75% marks or 7.5 CGPA. ME/MTech in Geotechnical/Structural Engineering with 75% marks or 7.5 CGPA. Knowledge on finite element software like ABAQUS, PLAXIS preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) for hiring eligible candidates under the Civil Engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research under advertisement number IIT/SRIC/R/LBS/2026/103.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for IIT Kharagpur JRF recruitment is 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of up to 37000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course with NET/GATE qualification or equivalent national level exam.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for General, OBC, Female, SC, and ST category candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply through the online mode by visiting the official IIT Kharagpur website and submitting their applications before the deadline.
